about_the_game:
"A unique action-adventure game where every reaction shapes a meaningful story."

The green community of Rootbranch 12 is perched atop a mountain at an altitude of 3,110 meters, embraced intermittently by permanent misty clouds. It is built on a giant Oak tree! This small community has undergone significant changes recently. Often, the darker side of each resident prevails, making the entire situation go from bad to worse. The Oak tree grieves silently.

Can you save Rootbranch 12? Can your positive energy and light dispel the shadows, or will malice prevail?

This 2D side-scrolling game focuses on precision platforming, mental and physical combat, and perception-reaction choices.

Choose how you perceive the world, raise the corresponding perception, and earn points to improve your abilities.

Innovative reaction system: It encourages players to react naturally—either from the heart or the mind—without revealing their response in advance. Essentially, it forces players to predict their reactions as in real life, along with the irreversible consequences that follow.

Features include an original soundtrack with 37 unique tracks, light RPG elements, item collection and usage, unpredictable NPC behavior, different ways to progress, multi-direction combat, environmental puzzles, a day-night cycle, weapon upgrades, a philosophical story approach, multiple endings, and even a mini-game.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 18.04+ (or equivalent distro)
  • Processor: Dual Core 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.3 compatible graphics (Intel HD 4000+)
  • Storage: 650 MB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.13 High Sierra or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (2012 or newer)
